title: Off-Peak Rebill Credits under Residential Electricity Supply
content:
**Rule.** On a Residential Electricity Supply agreement, the rebill credit for an over-billed off-peak line is the off-peak rebill amount determined for that line rather than the bare over-billed amount, and it is posted as a negative amount tied to the corrected line.

A rebill credit is not posted until every over-billed line of the agreement whose correction exceeds the care agent's adjustment limit stands as an open billing dispute.

**Scope of the correction.** This correction applies to the most recently posted off-peak energy line of a time-of-use agreement, the off-peak energy line with the latest posting date. When that line's off-peak rebill amount would exceed the care agent's adjustment limit, it is not credited here but referred to billing review as a billing dispute.

**Business effect.** Once posted, the agreement's bill lines carry a rebill credit line pointing at the corrected line, in that line's billing cycle; it reduces the supply charges billed and appears on the customer's next utility bill.

## Posting action

**Capability.** `post_rebill_credit_41f05139` posts one rebill credit that corrects one over-billed Beacon Ridge electricity bill line. A new line of the rebill kind is added to the agreement's bill lines, pointing at the original line it corrects and carrying the billing cycle of that line, the amount as a negative (credit) value and today's posting date.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks `post_rebill_credit_41f05139` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `power_agreement_id` | The residential electricity agreement number the corrected line belongs to, as read from the agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `source_billing_id` | The reference number of the original bill line being corrected, as read from the bill-line lookup of the agreement | Identifier |
| `billing_period_start` | The first day of the billing cycle of the corrected line | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `rebill_amount_usd` | The size of the rebill credit | Positive amount in USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; the line stores it signed as a negative credit |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new rebill line number, the agreement, the corrected line number and the credited amount in USD. Receiving it means the rebill credit now stands on the bill.
